public.hero.title: Mokhahlelo oa sejalo o baloa ka boemo ba leholimo bo bileng teng
public.hero.intro: Mecropolis e kopanya matsatsi a mocheso oa kholo ho tloha ha ho jaloa, e sebelisa mocheso o tlalehiloeng ke Open-Meteo. Ha kakaretso e fihla moeling oa sejalo, sehla sa Kapa Bophirimela se fetela mokhahlelong o latelang.

public.how.title: Ho tloha letsatsing la ho jala ho ea mokhahlelong
public.how.lead: Hangata mokhahlelo o kenngoa ka letsoho, kahoo o nepahetse feela ho fihlela ntlafatsong ea ho qetela. Mona o baloa ka boemo ba leholimo bo tlalehiloeng, 'me phetoho ka 'ngoe e boloka bopaki ba eona.
public.step.1.title: Ngola seo molemi a se tsebang
public.step.1.body: Mapolasi, masimo, lijalo le matsatsi a ho jala li bolokoa ho Sanity.
public.step.2.title: Nka boemo ba leholimo bo bileng teng
public.step.2.body: Mocheso oa letsatsi le letsatsi sebakeng sa tšimo o tsoa polokelong ea Open-Meteo, ho tloha ha ho jaloa ho fihlela kajeno.
public.step.3.title: Kopanya matsatsi a mocheso
public.step.3.body: Matsatsi a mocheso oa kholo (GDD) a kopanngoa ho latela mohlala oa sejalo. Ha kakaretso e feta moeli, tsamaiso e fetisetsa sehla mokhahlelong o latelang ebe e tlaleha lebaka.
public.models.title: Mehlala ea lijalo e sebelisoang
public.models.lead: Matsatsi a mocheso a hlokahalang hore sejalo se butsoe. Lipalo tsena li ngotsoe ka letsoho 'me ha li e-so be le mehloli.
public.live.title: Maemo polasing ea mohlala ea Swartland
public.live.lead: Lintlha tse tsoang mehloling ea sechaba, li ntlafatsoa metsotso e meng le e meng e 30.
public.yields.title: Litekanyetso tsa chai tse phatlalalitsoeng
public.honesty.title: Kamoo lintlha li sebetsoang kateng
public.honesty.1.title: Chai e kenngoa ke mosebelisi
public.honesty.1.body: Ho fihlela mosebedisi a ngola chai, app e bontsha “Ha e so ngolwe”.
public.honesty.2.title: Dipalo tsa papiso di bolokwa ka thoko
public.honesty.2.body: Dipalo tsa lebatowa le tsa naha di bolokwa ditokomaneng tsa tsona, le mohlodi le yuniti. Ha di bapiswe le chai ya tshimo.
public.honesty.3.title: Direkoto tsa disenyi ke tsa lebatowa
public.honesty.3.body: Direkoto tsa GBIF di bontshwa e le moo disenyi di bonweng teng ka hara 100 km, le bohole.
public.honesty.4.title: Boemo ba lehodimo ke ba hona jwale
public.honesty.4.body: Mocheso o nkuwa polokelong ya Open-Meteo ha o kopuwa.
public.open.title: Bula sehla
public.open.body: Kena deshebodong ya teko ho bona mothinya wa GDD wa sehla le bopaki ba mokgahlelo wa sona.

public.about.title: Ka rona
public.about.heading: Ka Mecropolis
public.about.lead: Mecropolis ke sesebediswa sa ho sala morao masimo le dijalo polasing ya Kapa Bophirima.
public.about.why.title: Lebaka la yona
public.about.why.body: Mekhahlelo ya masimo e a siuwa ke nako, mme chai e kenngwa ka ho hopola. Mecropolis e bala mokgahlelo ka boemo ba lehodimo bo rekotilweng. Nomoro ka nngwe e tswa ho mosebedisi kapa mohloding wa setjhaba o boletsweng.
public.about.design.title: Moralo
public.about.design.1.body: Diyuniti tsa mocheso di bokellwa ho tloha letsatsing la ho jala, ho sebediswa polokelo ya Open-Meteo. Phetoho ka nngwe ya mokgahlelo e boloka bopaki ba yona: letsatsi leo e qadileng ka lona, kakaretso ya GDD le seo e badilweng ho sona.
public.about.design.2.body: Mokgahlelo o latelang wa pele ho kotulo o bitswa ho butswa ka mocheso hobane ha ho ketsahalo ya kotulo e rekotilweng.
public.about.design.4.lead: Dipalo tsa papiso di fana ka moelelo.
public.about.design.4.body: Di bolokwa ditokomaneng tsa tsona, le mohlodi, yuniti le laesense.
public.about.stack.title: Theknoloji
public.about.stack.body: App ya leqephe le le leng ya Vite le React 19 ho Cloudflare Pages. Sebadi se bala dintlha tsa setjhaba tsa Sanity ka kotloloho ka GROQ le momamedi wa nako ya nnete. Dintlha tse ngolwang le tse hlokang senotlolo di feta ho Cloudflare Pages Functions, tse hlahlobang cookie ya seshene e saennweng. Zod e hlahloba dintlha tse kenang le tse tswang, Vitest ke ya diteko, mme Tailwind 4 ke ya setaele.
public.about.limits.title: Meedi e tsejwang
public.about.limits.1: Ditekanyetso tsa mohlala wa sejalo (mocheso wa motheo, nako ya mocheso ho fihlela se mela le ho butswa) di ngotswe ka letsoho mme ha di eso be le mehlodi.
public.about.limits.2: Palo ya papiso ya lupine e tswa ho HarvestStat bakeng sa 2000 ho isa ho 2007 feela, mme ho kenya dintlha tsa pele ha hoa fumana ditokomane tsa papiso tsa lupine.
public.about.limits.3: Dintlha tsa disenyi ke direkoto tsa GBIF tse haufi le polasi. Di bontsha moo mofuta o ileng wa rekotwa haufi le polasi.
public.about.limits.4: Teko e na le akhaonto e le nngwe e sebediswang ke bohle le moedi wa dikopo o bolokwang memoring. Ho kena ho pata maqephe a desheboto empa ha ho sireletse dintlha: bohle ba ka bala pokello ya dintlha. Empa ho sireletsa tsohle tse ngolwang.

docs.stages.title: Tsamaiso ya mekhahlelo
docs.stages.intro: Dihla di fetela pele ka mekhahlelo e tsheletseng:
docs.stages.guards: Mohato ka mong o na le dipehelo. Ho jalwa ho hloka letsatsi la ho jala le sejalo; ho hola ho hloka moedi wa ho mela ka diyuniti tsa mocheso; pele ho kotulo ho hloka 90% ya moedi wa ho butswa; ho butswa ka mocheso ho hloka hore moedi wa ho butswa o fihlellwe; tlhahlobo e hloka kakaretso ya boemo ba lehodimo ba sehla le palo ya papiso e netefaditsweng. Dipehelo tsa GDD di boetse di hloka dintlha tsa mocheso bakeng sa bonyane 90% ya nako, mme mohato o nang le letsatsi la ho qala le tlang o a thibelwa.

guide.title: Mokhoa oa ho sebelisa Mecropolis
guide.lead: Tataiso e khutšoanyane ka mantsoe a bonolo. E hlalosa hore sesebelisoa sena ke sa eng, se etselitsoe mang le hore karolo ka 'ngoe e etsa eng.
guide.what.title: Mecropolis ke eng
guide.what.p1: Mecropolis e sala masimo le lijalo morao. E lekanya hore sejalo ka seng se holile hakae ka ho bokella mofuthu oo se o fumaneng ho tloha ha se lengoa. E boetse e bontša boemo ba leholimo, mobu le likokoanyana tse haufi le polasi sebakeng se le seng.
guide.what.p2: E etselitsoe mapolasi a Kapa Bophirimela Afrika Boroa, empa e ka sebelisoa polasing efe kapa efe, sebakeng sefe kapa sefe le nakong efe kapa efe ea temo.
guide.who.title: E etselitsoe mang
guide.who.p1: E etselitsoe motho ea hlokomelang masimo, joalo ka molemi, mookameli oa polasi kapa moeletsi ea ba thusang.
guide.who.p2: Ha ho hlokahale hore u tsebe likhomphutha kapa saense ea boemo ba leholimo. Haeba u khona ho bula websaete, u ka sebelisa Mecropolis.
guide.why.title: Lebaka la ho e sebelisa
guide.why.1: U ka bona hang-hang hore na ke lijalo life tse sa tsoa lengoa, tse ntseng li hola le tse seng li batla li loketse.
guide.why.2: Ha ho hlokahale hore u ntlafatse tšimo ka 'ngoe ka letsoho. Sesebelisoa se fetisetsa sejalo mohato o latelang ha boemo ba leholimo bo bontša hore nako e fihlile.
guide.why.3: Se u lemosa ka serame le mocheso matsatsing a tlang, le ka likokoanyana tse bonoeng haufi le polasi.
guide.why.4: Tsohle tse ngotsoeng ka tšimo, joalo ka ho fafatsa, kokoanyana eo u e boneng kapa molaetsa, li lula sebakeng se le seng li e-na le letsatsi, hore u tle u li shebe hamorao.
guide.why.5: Nomoro ka 'ngoe e bontša moo e tsoang teng, hore u tsebe hore na u ka tšepa eng.
guide.heat.title: Sesebelisoa se tseba joang hore sejalo se boemong bofe
guide.heat.p1: Limela li hola kapele ha ho futhumetse, 'me butle ha ho bata. Letsatsi le letsatsi Mecropolis e bala mofuthu ona e le diyuniti tsa mocheso, tseo borasaense ba li bitsang growing degree days kapa GDD.
guide.heat.p2: Letsatsi ka leng e nka mocheso o bohareng pakeng tsa o phahameng le o tlase, ebe e tlosa mocheso oo sejalo se khaotsang ho hola ho oona. Se setseng ke diyuniti tsa mocheso tsa letsatsi leo. Letsatsi le batang ha le kenye letho.
guide.heat.p3: Sejalo ka seng se hloka kakaretso e itseng ea diyuniti tsa mocheso pele se loka. Ha kakaretso ea ho tloha ha se lengoa e atamela palo eo, sejalo se fetela mohatong o latelang.
guide.heat.p4: Mocheso o tsoa ho Open-Meteo, tšebeletso ea mahala e bolokang boemo ba leholimo ba libaka tsohle lefatšeng.
guide.stages.title: Mehato e tšeletseng
guide.stages.intro: Sejalo se seng le se seng tšimong ka 'ngoe se feta mehatong ena ka tatellano ena.
guide.stages.planning: Nako ea temo e se e hlophisitsoe, empa sejalo ha se e-s'o lengoe.
guide.stages.planted: Letsatsi la ho lema le fetile.
guide.stages.growing: Sejalo se ntse se bokella diyuniti tsa mocheso.
guide.stages.preHarvest: Sejalo se bokelletse boholo ba mofuthu oo se o hlokang, kahoo ke nako ea ho itokisetsa kotulo.
guide.stages.harvested: Sejalo se bokelletse mofuthu oohle oo se o hlokang, kahoo se lokela ho ba se loketse. Ke uena feela ea ka bolelang hore na se kotutsoe e le kannete, kahoo sesebelisoa se re se butsoitse ka mocheso.
guide.stages.review: Nako ea temo e felile, 'me u ka sheba hore na e tsamaile joang.
guide.stages.p2: Sesebelisoa se hlahloba sejalo ka seng bosiu bo bong le bo bong le ha motho a kenya seo a se boneng kapa mosebetsi o entsoeng. U ka boela ua tobetsa Hlahloba hona joale nakong ea temo hore se hlahlobe hang-hang.
guide.start.title: Ho qala
guide.start.1: Bula leqephe la pele. U ka bona 'mapa oa boemo ba leholimo, mobu, likokoanyana le chai tsa polasi ea mohlala ntle le ho kena.
guide.start.2: Tobetsa Kena ka holimo, ebe u sebelisa lintlha tsa ak'haonte ea mohlala tseo u li filoeng.
guide.start.3: Khetha polasi. Sena se bula leqephe la kakaretso la polasi eo.
guide.start.4: Tobetsa nako ea temo ho bona tsohle ka sejalo seo tšimong eo.
guide.start.5: Sebelisa lebokose la puo ka holimo leqepheng lefe kapa lefe ho fetola puo. Sesebelisoa se tla hopola khetho ea hao nakong e tlang.
guide.home.title: Leqephe la pele
guide.home.p1: Leqephe la pele le bontša 'mapa oa sebaka o mebala ho latela mofuthu oo mobu o o fumaneng nakong ena ea temo. Le boetse le bontša boemo ba leholimo ba hona joale le ba matsatsi a tlang, mobu oa polasi ea mohlala, likokoanyana tse sa tsoa bonoa haufi le moo le chai e tloaelehileng ea sebaka. Ha ho hlokahale hore u kene ho li bona.
guide.dashboard.title: Leqephe la kakaretso la polasi
guide.dashboard.intro: Leqephe lena le bontša polasi e le 'ngoe. Likarolo tsa lona ke tsena ho tloha holimo ho ea tlase. Lebokose la polasi le ka holimo le u lumella ho ea polasing e 'ngoe.
guide.dashboard.summary.label: Kakaretso ea polasi
guide.dashboard.summary: Palo ea masimo le lihekthere tsa polasi, linako tsa temo tse ntseng li tsoela pele le lijalo tse seng li loketse.
guide.dashboard.alerts.label: Tse hlokang tlhokomelo
guide.dashboard.alerts: Litemoso tse khutšoanyane, joalo ka serame kapa mocheso ponelopeleng, sejalo se seng se loketse, nako ea temo e sa qalang ka nako kapa likokoanyana tse bonoeng haufi le tšimo. Temoso ka 'ngoe e bolela sesosa sa eona.
guide.dashboard.conditions.label: Maemo a polasi
guide.dashboard.conditions: Boemo ba leholimo ba kajeno, ponelopele, mobu le likokoanyana tse haufi le polasi ena.
guide.dashboard.progress.label: Tsoelo-pele ea nako ea temo
guide.dashboard.progress: Karete ea sejalo ka seng e bontšang hore se bokelletse mofuthu o mokae. U ka bapisa masimo 'moho, 'me ua jarolla lenane e le faele ea spreadsheet (CSV).
guide.dashboard.fields.label: Masimo
guide.dashboard.fields: Masimo 'ohle a polasi, boholo ba 'ona, mobu le lijalo tsa 'ona.
guide.dashboard.search.label: Batla lirekoto
guide.dashboard.search: Ngola seo u se batlang ka mantsoe a tloaelehileng, joalo ka hoaba koro. E fumana lintho tse bonoeng le mesebetsi e entsoeng tse bolelang ntho e tšoanang, leha ho sebelisitsoe mantsoe a mang.
guide.dashboard.recommendations.label: Litlhahiso
guide.dashboard.recommendations: Mosebetsi o khothaletsoang tšimong, joalo ka ho fafatsa kapa ho tšela manyolo. U ka amohela kapa ua hana tlhahiso ka 'ngoe, 'me ua e tšoaea e phethiloe ha mosebetsi o felile.
guide.dashboard.activity.label: Mesebetsi ea morao tjena
guide.dashboard.activity: Lenane la linako tseo sejalo ka seng se fetetseng mohatong o mocha.
guide.season.title: Leqephe la nako ea temo
guide.season.intro: Nako ea temo ke sejalo se le seng tšimong e le 'ngoe selemong se le seng. Leqephe la eona le na le tsohle ka eona.
guide.season.top.label: Ka holimo leqepheng
guide.season.top: Sejalo, tšimo, letsatsi la ho lema, nako e lebelletsoeng ea kotulo le chai ha u se u e kentse.
guide.season.pipeline.label: Tatellano ea mehato
guide.season.pipeline: Mehato e tšeletseng, 'me oa hona joale o tšoailoe. Tobetsa Hlahloba hona joale ho bona hang-hang hore na sejalo se lokela ho fetela pele.
guide.season.readiness.label: Ho loka bakeng sa mohato o latelang
guide.season.readiness: Lenane la lintho tseo sesebelisoa se li hlokang pele se fetisetsa sejalo pele, joalo ka letsatsi la ho lema le lintlha tse lekaneng tsa boemo ba leholimo. Ntho ka 'ngoe e re E lokile, Temoso kapa E thibetsoe. E thibetsoeng e bolela se haellang.
guide.season.evidence.label: Bopaki
guide.season.evidence: Lirekoto tseo sesebelisoa se li sebelisitseng ho etsa liqeto, hore u tle u li hlahlobe.
guide.season.propose.label: Etsa tlhahiso
guide.season.propose: Khothaletsa mosebetsi oa tšimo ena, u kenye le bopaki ba nako ea temo. E lula e le moralo ho fihlela motho a e amohela leqepheng la kakaretso.
guide.season.gdd.label: Growing degree days
guide.season.gdd: Chate ea diyuniti tsa mocheso tse bokellanang ho tloha ha ho lengoa, e nang le mola oa kakaretso eo sejalo se e hlokang.
guide.season.whatIf.label: Ho ka etsahala'ng?
guide.season.whatIf: Leka letsatsi la ho lema la pejana kapa la hamorao, kapa nako ea temo e futhumetseng kapa e batang ho feta, 'me u bone hore na diyuniti tsa mocheso li ka fetoha joang. Ha ho letho le bolokoang.
guide.season.summary.label: Kakaretso ea nako ea temo
guide.season.summary: Kakaretso e khutšoanyane ea lirekoto tsa nako ea temo e ngotsoeng ke AI. E sebelise e le thuso, 'me u hlahlobe lirekoto ha ho bonahala ho na le phoso.
guide.season.notes.label: Lintlha tsa nako ea temo
guide.season.notes: Lintlha tsa nako ea temo tse nang le matsatsi. U ka li kenya, ua li fetola kapa ua li hlakola, 'me ua khutlisa mofuta oa khale oa ntlha.
guide.season.files.label: Setšoantšo sa tšimo le tlaleho ea tlhahlobo ea mobu
guide.season.files: Kenya setšoantšo sa tšimo le PDF ea tlhahlobo ea mobu e tsoang laboratoring.
guide.season.log.label: Rekoto ea tšimo
guide.season.log: Seo u se boneng tšimong le seo u se entseng ho eona, joalo ka ho fafatsa, sehlahisoa se sebelisitsoeng le tekanyo ea sona.
guide.season.history.label: Nalane ea liphetoho
guide.season.history: Phetoho e 'ngoe le e 'ngoe e bolokiloeng nakong ena ea temo, hammoho le letsatsi la eona.
guide.season.benchmark.label: Papiso ea sebaka
guide.season.benchmark: Chai e tloaelehileng ea sebaka e tsoang lipalong tsa sechaba. Ke ea ho bapisa feela, ha se chai ea tšimo ea hao.
guide.season.pests.label: Likokoanyana tse tlalehiloeng sebakeng
guide.season.pests: Likokoanyana tse tlalehiloeng haufi le tšimo ho GBIF, pokello ea sechaba ea lipono. Tobetsa Lata lipono ho fumana tsa morao-rao.
guide.sources.title: Lipalo li tsoa hokae
guide.sources.weather: Boemo ba leholimo bo tsoa ho Open-Meteo bakeng sa kajeno, ponelopele le matsatsi a fetileng.
guide.sources.soil: Lintlha tsa mobu li tsoa ho SoilGrids, 'mapa oa mobu oa lefatše.
guide.sources.pests: Lipono tsa likokoanyana li tsoa ho GBIF, pokello ea sechaba ea lipono.
guide.sources.yields: Chai ea sebaka e tsoa ho USDA FAS, HarvestStat-Africa le World Bank.
guide.sources.you: Tse ling tsohle, joalo ka lintlha, mesebetsi e entsoeng le chai ea hao, li kentsoe ke uena kapa sehlopha sa hao.
guide.limits.title: Seo e ke keng ea se etsa
guide.limits.model: Diyuniti tsa mocheso tseo sejalo ka seng se li hlokang ke likhakanyo tsa rona, 'me ha li e-s'o lekoe tšimong. Li sebelise e le tataiso, 'me u tšepe seo u se bonang tšimong ea hao.
guide.limits.maturity: Ho butsoa ka mocheso ho bolela hore boemo ba leholimo bo bontša hore sejalo se lokela ho be se lokile. Ke uena feela ea tsebang hore na se hlile se lokile.
guide.limits.translation: Liphetolelo li ngotsoe ke AI. Li lokela ho utloahala habonolo, empa ha lia hlahlojoa kaofela ke motho ea buang puo eo.
guide.limits.demo: Demo e buletsoe bohle, kahoo u se ke ua kenya litaba tsa lekunutu.
